title: stage_add_shape MCP tool does not support bitmap fills
description: The model's Fill type includes BitmapFill (type: 'bitmap', bitmapId, repeat, smooth, matrix) but buildFill() in registry.ts only handles solid and gradient fills. Agents cannot create shapes with bitmap fills via stage_add_shape and must resort to jsfl_run. Fix: add a BitmapFillParam case to buildFill that accepts { type: 'bitmap', bitmapId, repeat?, smooth?, matrix? }.
